Public Relations (PR)
Interactions
CoinPedia / TradingView / Binance / Bitget / Kripto World / Blogtienao
: Secured expert interactions featuring Nischal Shetty on crypto ETFs, market maturity, volatility outlook, and asset-specific trends including Bitcoin and XRP.
Authored Article
CoinPasar
:
Featured an authored article by Nischal Shetty on “India’s Next Leap: Why the Country Is Poised to Become the World’s First On-Chain Nation.” Coverage Secured.
Press Announcements
Shardeum and ITM Memorandum of Understanding
: Announcement on Shardeum and ITM, Navi Mumbai Signing MoU to Advance Web3 Education in Maharashtra was disseminated and secured coverage across Divya Bhaskar, Thane Vaibhav, Mumbai Lakshdeep, Punyanagari, Gujarat Samachar, Loktantr Live, Navbharat, Navarashtra, and Vedant Samachar, among others.
The
Delegators Program Launch:
The announcement of Shardeum launching its Delegators Program with an estimated 218% APY was disseminated and secured coverage across MENAFN, PNI, Business News This Week, Biz News Desk, Media Bulletins, Online Media Café, and other platforms.
Humanode Partnership
: Announcement on Shardeum partnering with Humanode to integrate human-centric digital identity into Web3 secured coverage across Adgully, Media Brief, SME Street, CXO Today, IBS Intelligence, Alexa Blockchain, Coin Trust, MEXC, and multiple business publications.
Shardeum Introduces Human-Readable. shm Domains with ZNS Connect
: Announcement introducing human-readable .shm domains was covered across Media Infoline, Coin Trust, Bitget, KuCoin, Phemex, Blockchain Reporter, MEXC, and other global exchanges and crypto media.
Shardeum signs MoU with GCOEN in Nagpur
: Announcements around Shardeum’s MoUs with GCOEN Nagpur to fast-track Web3 talent development secured extensive regional coverage across Nagpur-based publications, including Navbharat, Dainik Bhaskar, Navrashtra, Lokshahi Warta, Deshonnati, and Tarun Bharat, among others.

General Highlights
Shardeum Community Delegators program launched with following milestones achieved as of December
Total SHM staked: 1.24B SHM
Community staked: 759M+ SHM
Community validators: 12
Estimated APY: ~52%
Two new dApps onboarded to the ecosystem – Biomapper’s Humanode (Digital Identity) and ZNS Connect (Domain Naming)
Launched Proof of Community India onchain tour on December 8th to create awareness about onchain and dApp ecosystem.
Read more
Shardeum’s flagship events program ‘Proof of Community’ completed 500 meetups.
Read more
Up to 100 million SHM were distributed through the EVM Testnet Quest and Proof of Keys Airdrop programs conducted between August and October 2025.
Trading contest in collaboration with Cedehub (7 days, 1 mn+ trade volume generated by 460 unique traders )
To celebrate the builders and community members who helped shape Shardeum in 2025, we opened a submission process for a special NFT honoring their contributions.
Developer
documentation
of running a validator, full, and RPC nodes completed
Thank you all! We’ll be back with more updates for January 2026.
